p.i: Nec qui nunc tacet hoc iacens sepulchro,
QVI procul hinc veteres tumulos, signataque passim
Hic quoque siste[?] pede. Parvo hic sub cespite summi
Monanius, dicent, si quaeris cetera, moesta,
Monanios totum dum conscia fama per orbem
Scilicet, ut terras alter repleret, & alter
O fortunatos fratres, quorum unus honori

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "siste" (printed as "sisle", with a long-s-like form) is marked [?]. The Greek word "ἀρχίατρος" is copied as best read from the scan; its accents may need checking. The opening mark before "procul" (printed "QVI'") was read as QVI. "Monanios" and "Monanium" are printed as shown. The first stanza continues from the previous page.
